topic: Sea otters hold hands while they sleep
script: Sea otters sometimes hold hands while they sleep so they do not drift apart. They also wrap themselves in kelp to stay anchored in one place. Sea otters have the thickest fur of any animal, up to about a million hairs per square inch. Unlike whales and seals, they have no blubber, so air trapped in their fur keeps them warm. They use rocks as tools to crack open clams and urchins. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
